notes.title: Minor update: Levelization and changes in level scenes.
notes.notes: Now there are levels in the game. The scene of the levels has become wider.

notes.title: Bug fixes and pathes
notes.notes:
Some visual effects have been optimized.
Some values have been adjusted to adapt to the new scene size.
Some bugs have been fixed, such as the mismatch between vision and physics when the wind blows.

notes.title: Bug fixes and UI reset and View changes
notes.notes:
We are very pleased to resume and continue the update. Here are the changes to the test branch this time:
1.After repeated testing, I have decided to improve the overly compact UI design of the game. In this update, the overall UI has been changed. The map now has more space, and there are also related visual effect optimizations.
2. Ana can now shoot under the correct cooldown limit.
The camera is more flexible. It now focuses better on Mario and comes with a certain easing effect.
3. Considering the current scene structure, some reward mechanisms are no longer applicable. Future updates will focus on new reward mechanisms.

notes.title: Update the shop, and make the vfx and sfx better
notes.notes:
The store system has been updated. Players can obtain gold coins and strengthen themselves in the store.
The audio has been optimized. Now the audio feedback will be richer and more direct, but it may still not be pleasant enough.
The visual shooting feedback has been enhanced.
We hope to receive more feedback from players.
